summary.plain_language_summary: Harold’s records show several issues that should be reviewed promptly with his care team. His INR is above the clinic’s stated goal, and he reports easy bruising and bleeding gums; his hemoglobin is also low and has fallen from an earlier result. The medication lists include possible overlaps or discrepancies, including two blood-thinning medicines in addition to naproxen, two statins, and two medicines for urinary symptoms. His standing dizziness and nighttime fall may be important to review alongside the nighttime urination and medication list. Kidney results have worsened and potassium is above the lab’s range, so these results also need timely follow-up. The specialists’ reports do not establish which medicines are intended; the prescribers and anticoagulation clinic can reconcile the complete list together.
